purpose: Homepage link-preview video (og:video) for apps that play a direct MP4 inline; og:image remains the fallback

scene.kind: Project-made 3D miniature generated entirely in code (procedural three.js geometry and textures, rendered offline)
scene.depiction: Generic low-poly mountain switchbacks with small rider groups; no third-party footage, product or exact-model claim

signature.mascot: Site red-panda cyclist from its approved generated source (sha256 14a201c57d9ca2a95416fd12e7beb17ad248ed187d24636a6e8a98d70d23e46d; assets/branding/provenance.json), riding in place: a code rig redraws the legs, cranks, pedals and spokes in the artwork's own colours, restores the frame tubes the legs covered, sways the tail and bobs the body slightly; the head, helmet, face, jersey, arms, hands, handlebar, frame and wheel rings keep the original artwork
signature.typeface: Apple system font (SF) rasterised into the frames; no font file is distributed

output.codec: H.264 High, yuv420p, BT.709, 30 fps, no audio, fast start
output.encoding: libx264 veryslow, CRF 22, from a visually lossless 1280x720 master, Lanczos-downscaled
